Description: Copy this file to flowgen/configs/<block>.config.csv, edit the Value column, save as CSV, then run: flowgen/csv2config.py flowgen/configs/<block>.config.csv. One value per row. For a list, add more rows below with the same Setting name (or leave the Setting cell empty). Rows whose Setting starts with # are headings. An empty Value means not set here: the project config value or the default is used. LibreOffice: when opening, set the Value column type to Text so values like 4:0:0 are not changed.
Shared settings (PROJ_ROOT, libraries, tool setup) come from project.config.tcl.
Read the project settings first. Everything below can change them for this block.
Optional helper variables, used below as $NAME. flowgen does not need them.
Name of the block's directory under $PROJ_ROOT.
Example helper variable. Leave empty if not used.
Top-level design (module) name.
Flows to generate, one row each. Default: rtl2syn (RTL vs synthesized netlist).
RTL language: sverilog (default), verilog or vhdl.
Directories searched, in order, for RTL file names without a full path (in RTL_FILES and inside .f files). One row per directory.
RTL files or .f file lists, one row each. A .f file has one file per line; // and # start comments; $NAME is a config variable, else an environment variable.
Include directories for `include files, one row each. RTL file names are also looked up here. Not for vhdl.
Verilog macros, NAME or NAME=VALUE, one row each. Not for vhdl.
Directories searched, in order, for netlist file names without a full path. One row per directory.
Synthesized netlist files or .f file lists, one row each.
Place-and-route netlist files or .f file lists. Not used by rtl2syn.
SVF guidance file from synthesis. Recommended for Formality. Leave empty if there is none.
Timing constraint files, one row each. Not used by Formality.
Power intent files, one row each. Not used by flowgen yet.
Verilog models for hard IPs or cells without a library model, one row each. Read into both reference and implementation.
Modules to black box, one row each. Nothing is black boxed unless listed here.

Setting: # PROJECT SETTINGS FOR THIS BLOCK ONLY
Description: Usually set in project.config.tcl. Fill a value only to change it for this block.
Library file format: db (read_db) or lib (.lib or .lib.gz, read_lib).
Library files, one row each. Only these exact files are read. A value here replaces the project list.
Shell setup files sourced by the run script, one row each. Arguments may follow the file name.
Environment variable set by the run script: ENV_SETENV(<NAME>). One row per variable.
Command that starts Formality. Default: fm_shell
Any Formality variable: TOOL_SETTINGS(formality,<variable>), written as set_app_var. One row per variable.
Your own Tcl file sourced in the Formality script. Hook points: setup, pre_match, pre_verify, post_verify.
